## Time Series

```{r humidity-hourly}
humidity_plots<-if(
  
  (data %>% 
       dplyr::filter(PARAMETER %in% toupper("humidity") & !is.na(RAW_VALUE)) %>%
       nrow(.))==0
  
) {htmltools::tags$p("There is no data for this parameter.")} else {
  
  plotly_fcn(data,
                        all_data,

            parameter=toupper("humidity"))
  
  
}

htmltools::tagList(humidity_plots)
```
